svg.title: Continuous architectural gallery
svg.metadata: Native vector gallery. Projects 01, 02 and 04 retain their existing geometry and pen strokes. Project 03 redrawn from supplied 6666.obj, Y-up, azimuth 165 and elevation 10 degrees. Preserves four canopy bays, seven stepped seating levels, primary timber structure and wheel silhouettes. Uniform scaling; hidden lines and dense plank seams omitted; variable pen weight.
